name: shot-annotate
description: Adds numbered arrows to the screenshots in a folder you choose, for bug reports.
---
Install the dependency once with `scripts/setup.sh`, then run `python3 scripts/annotate.py <folder>`.
files.scripts/annotate.py:
import sys, pathlib
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
for i, p in enumerate(sorted(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).glob("*.png")), 1):
    im = Image.open(p)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    d.line((20, 20, 120, 120), fill="red", width=6)
    d.text((124, 124), str(i), fill="red")
    im.save(p.with_name(p.stem + "-annotated.png"))
